description: Fork a saved build into a new autosaved draft: a variant with its own build ID, preserving the original build. The fork copies the uploader configuration and media references and can be edited independently. Returns the source build ID and the new build with its url. Each call creates another fork.

buildId.description: Saved build ID to duplicate, e.g. build_abc123...

name: ads_fork_build
title: Fork Saved Build
